description: This file provides utility functions for compiling glob patterns which are used to match string values against patterns. It defines types for compiled patterns, functions to compile individual glob patterns and arrays of patterns, and a function to check if a string matches any pattern in a list.

methods.name: function escapeRegex(value: string) { escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string so it can be safely used in a regular expression literal.

methods.name: export function compileGlobPattern(params: { compileGlobPattern
methods.description: Compiles a raw string into a pattern object indicating whether it matches all, an exact string, or a regex based on wildcards.

methods.name: export function compileGlobPatterns(params: { compileGlobPatterns
methods.description: Processes an array of raw strings into an array of compiled pattern objects, filtering out 'exact' patterns with empty strings.

methods.name: export function matchesAnyGlobPattern(value: string, patterns: CompiledGlobPattern[]): boolean { matchesAnyGlobPattern
methods.description: Checks if a given string matches any pattern in a list of compiled glob patterns.
